rule: Maximize weighted expected complete 26-week profit over declared prices; same scope, quality and responsibility at every price. Fixed development weights are risk-neutral planning preferences, not empirical frequencies. Capacity and first-job funding are screened before ranking. STOP is allowed for a nonpositive maximum.
limitations: Analytical planning uses expected load and capacity, and full planned acquisition. Fresh campaigns enforce every cash prefix and may curtail acquisition; these development estimates are not observed operating outcomes.
